Greetings, and welcome to game development
.
We use dragonbones animations extensively, so I can offer some advice here.
First, as SGHarlekin said, you'll need to download the Dragonbones software. That software is how you can view and create animated monsters.
There's already tons of great Youtube videos explaining how to use Dragonbones itself, so I won't get into that here.
Let me get into directly answering the rest your questions here, and if you have more, you can reach out to me in this thread
.
PS: I can't view the google drive link you shared, it's locked, so I can't help with this specific battler.
Q: What happens if you change some parameters?
A: Not sure exactly what parameters you're speaking of, but if you mean changing the parameters in-engine as they relate to a Dragonbones Battler, they affect a variety of things. The most common ones to work with are those that create a Battler's hitbox and point the engine to where the Dragonbones assets are located. Some examples of parameters:
<Dragonbones Battler: ScaryMonster> (Points the engine to the assets named ScaryMonster)
<Dragonbones Battler Size: 214, 230> (hitbox related parameter)
<Dragonbones Battler Offset Y: -110> (hitbox related parameter)
<Dragonbones Battler Offset X: -10> (hitbox related parameter)
Q: What happens if I change the PNG image?
A: Try it! If you mean what happens if you change the image in-engine, what is going to happen is...nothing. Dragonbones Battlers do not use in-engine images, they use images assigned to them in their libraries/assets.
Q: How does the engine understand Dragonbones code?
A: This is accomplished through a plugin. The one we use is here:
https://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/Dragonbones_Union_VisuStella_MZ
From what I understand, you can also get this plugin through Aekashics' Patreon.
You will also need the free plugin called Public_0_Dragonbones that comes with the purchase.
----------------
Hope all this info helps! Have a wonderful week
